categories.name: PS Emu
categories.rules:
**~PS Emu RULES~**
**Emulator:** PsxFin 1.13 recommended
**Difficulty:** Normal

**NOT ALLOWED:**
* PAL 50Hz is banned  because the IGT counts differently compared with other regions.
* Muting the game audio. 
* Music from outside of the game.
* Turbo and Macro.
* Save States

categories.name: Duckstation
categories.rules:
**~Duckstation Emu RULES~**
**Emulator:** Duckstation 0.1-7675 Version or newer

**Duckstation-Settings:** Default Settings of Console/Emulation which have to be shown on the Screen via OSD and u need to show the Console/Emulation Settings from Duckstation before or after the Run

**Difficulty:** Normal

**NOT ALLOWED:**

- PAL 50Hz is banned  because the IGT counts differently compared with other regions.
- Muting the game audio. 
- Music from outside of the game.
- Turbo and Macro.
- Save States

categories.name: PC
categories.rules:
**~PC RULES~**

- GAME VERSIONS ALLOWED
- Sourcenext & Sourcenext with Classic REbirth SPEEDRUN EDITION
- Runs MUST contain Game Audio throughout the ENTIRE run.
- Runs MUST start from the title screen.
- Runs MUST end after the Result Screen.
- Runs MUST show In-Game Time with SRT or with LiveSplit script this was made mandatory from 2016-01-01.* * Obtain them [here](http://www.speedrun.com/re2/resources
)

**NOT ALLOWED:**

- Music from outside of the game.
- Muting the game audio.
- Turbo and Macro.
- Classic Rebirth WITHOUT Speedrun Edition
- Cutscene and doorskip runs must go in the cutscene skip category
- Cutscene Speedrun mod is NOT allowed
- HD Mods
- Outfit Mods

**NOT ALLOWED:**

runList.comment: Messy towards the end but what a run! So proud of myself for this achievement! Let gooooo!

THE GLORY IS FOR YOU GOD. I dedicate this to God, to my MOTHER who is the only one that always trusts in me, THIS IS FOR YOU MOM!!!, to the rest of my family and everybody in the chat who always supported me: Falcon, Benzhort, Uli, Joey, Rogers, thank you so much - Is this the end for me in Leon A?
the trigger (after crocodile fight) was so bad
Sub 49 and WR in the same run! SeemsGood
A nice end-of-year PB. Could have been a 49:10 but I panicked and shot the first naked zombie on the way to G4. Very close though.

Sound issues in the sewers again and livesplit crash at the end.
If someone know how to fix those issues please let me know, it happens to me very often.
